title: Founder case: Blue Ribbon Sports sells at track meets

sources.claim: Phil Knight and his former coach Bill Bowerman formed Blue Ribbon Sports in 1964 to distribute Onitsuka Tiger running shoes from Japan; Knight sold shoes from his car at regional track meets while working other jobs; the company became Nike after splitting from Onitsuka in 1971.

sections.skill: Apply a documented early decision: sell in person where customers gather

questions.intro: Documented history (Britannica): Phil Knight and his former coach Bill Bowerman formed Blue Ribbon Sports in 1964 to distribute Onitsuka Tiger running shoes from Japan. Knight sold shoes from his car at regional track meets while working other jobs. The company became Nike after splitting from Onitsuka in 1971. Lesson drawn by this course (an interpretation): go in person to the places where your most interested customers already gather, and start part time if you need income.
